digest.component_or_area: plan-review-T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: The T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks away from transient de-risk experiments while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth)

The scope clause stating transient throwaway experiments are out of scope must appear near the top of the T10 rubric with an immediately following co-located safety qualifier preserving the four MAJOR classes

A packaged eval spec with ten balanced dataset cases (five pass, five finding) must validate T10 behavior across durable lifecycle, transient probes, secret management, and untrusted-network scenarios
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and confirm T10 does not reference T15 or delegate scope to other overlays
The T10 criterion must be registered in NEW_SPECS and pass strict packaged-spec validation including schema, scorer discipline, dataset balance, and non-empty gold data
Live criteria eval with three runs must report correct pass/finding outcomes for all ten balanced cases and demonstrate full recall, zero false acceptance, and stable agreement across runs
